title: QANDA – An AI Tutor for everyone, advancing equity in education
summary: Mathpresso describes real-time question solving, adaptive feedback, and study plans through QANDA. Learning gains and reductions in educational inequality are not measured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Mathpresso describes real-time question solving, adaptive feedback, and study plans through QANDA. Learning gains and reductions in educational inequality are not measured. Deployed tutoring platform. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Expand access to personalized tutoring and self-directed study support.

ratings.reason: The provider describes real-time question solving and personalized study support, giving students convenient access to tutoring. Learning gains and enduring inclusion effects are not measured.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use case 2: QANDA – An AI Tutor for everyone, advancing equity in education

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.

headline: QANDA offers affordable AI tutoring

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
